description: This file defines classes and methods related to managing block files in a disk cache system, including BlockHeader and BlockFiles classes, with functions for creating, deleting, and validating block storage.

classes.name: BlockHeader
classes.description: Represents the header of a block file in memory, providing methods for managing storage blocks.

classes.name: BlockFiles
classes.description: Manages a set of open block files in the disk cache, providing methods for creating, deleting, and validating blocks.

methods.name: CreateMapBlock
methods.description: Creates a new entry of specified size on the allocation map.

methods.name: DeleteMapBlock
methods.description: Deletes the block at the specified index.

methods.name: UsedMapBlock
methods.description: Checks if a specified block is used.

methods.name: FixAllocationCounters
methods.description: Restores empty counters and allocation hints.

methods.name: NeedToGrowBlockFile
methods.description: Determines if the current block file needs to grow to accommodate more records.

methods.name: CanAllocate
methods.description: Checks if the file can store an extra record of given size.

methods.name: EmptyBlocks
methods.description: Returns the number of empty blocks.

methods.name: MinimumAllocations
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of allocations that can be satisfied.

methods.name: Capacity
methods.description: Returns the total number of blocks the file can store.

methods.name: ValidateCounters
methods.description: Validates the internal counters.

methods.name: FileId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of this file.

methods.name: NextFileId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the next file.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the BlockFileHeader structure.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the underlying BlockFileHeader.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the BlockFiles object, creating or opening files.

methods.name: GetFile
methods.description: Returns the file corresponding to a given address.

methods.name: CreateBlock
methods.description: Creates a new block entry in a block file.

methods.name: DeleteBlock
methods.description: Removes a block entry from the files.

methods.name: CloseFiles
methods.description: Closes all open files and resets internal state.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the blocks at a given address are currently used.
